difficulty_reason: For h : Z -> X formally unramified over B, the lemma produces the canonical exact sequence C_{Z/X} -> h^*Omega_{X/B} -> Omega_{Z/B} -> 0 whose first arrow comes from d_{Z'/B} on the universal first order thickening Z'. The retained proof is written as a two-step transfer: the relative-immersion differentials sequence for Z -> Z' (chapter lemma differentials-relative-immersion: C_{Z/Z'} -> Omega_{Z'/S} (x) O_Z -> Omega_{Z/S} -> 0, exact) is reidentified through the comparison lemma for formally unramified morphisms (chapter lemma differentials-universally-unramified), which converts the C_{Z/Z'} term into C_{Z/X} and the S-relative terms into B-relative ones, yielding the claim. Retained author proof at lines 3378-3389.
